name: Animated Title
description: A title that animates in and out letter by letter, word by word or line by line, in one of eight styles; *starred* words take a highlight colour.

controls.name: Text
controls.description: The title; words between stars (*like this*) take the Highlight Colour, and the stars are not shown.

controls.name: By
controls.description: What moves on its own, one after another.

controls.name: Stagger
controls.description: Seconds between one letter, word or line starting and the next; shortened for a long text so the move in takes at most a third of Duration (not used by Spread In).

controls.name: Ease
controls.description: 0 (even speed) to 100 (a fast start that settles slowly).

controls.name: Fade
controls.description: Animate in and out (default), in only, neither (Steady) or out only, to hold a title across several clips.

controls.name: Position
controls.description: Centre of the title, in frame pixels (9x16: [540, 960]).

controls.name: Size
controls.description: Size of the title: 50 is the normal size (a 120 px font in 16x9, 96 in 9x16), 100 is double.

controls.name: Max Width
controls.description: Widest the title may be, in % of the frame width; a wider one shrinks to fit.

controls.name: Shadow
controls.description: Strength of the soft shadow under the text, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When the first letter, word or line starts to move in, in seconds.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds; the move out ends 0.1 s before it.
